## A custom CRM gives your org an edge, but building one comes with tradeoffs\
\
### The Giant Monolith\
\
Proprietary languages, slow deployment cycles, and "black box" logic.\
\
### The In-house Burden\
\
It's fragile. V1 ships quickly, but maintaining and making changes is a long term burden.\
\
Stop settling for trade-offs.\
\
## Assemble, iterate and adapt a robust CRM, that's quick to flex\
\
Compose your CRM and internal apps with a single extensibility toolkit.\
\
### Production grade quality\
\
W3villa used Twenty as a production-grade framework for the data model, permissions, authentication, and workflow engine they would otherwise have rebuilt themselves.\
\
### AI for rapid iterations\
\
Alternative Partners used agentic AI to compress what would typically be weeks of Salesforce migration work into something a single person could oversee.\
\
### Control without drag\
\
AC&T moved to a self-hosted Twenty instance with no vendor risk, no forced migration, and CRM costs reduced by more than 90%.\

## Stop fighting custom. Start building, with Twenty\
\
[Get started](https://app.twenty.com/welcome) Talk to us\
\
### Is Twenty really open-source?\
\
Yes. Twenty is the #1 Open Source CRM on GitHub. You can self-host to fully own your infrastructure, or run it on our managed cloud for a zero-ops setup.\
\
### How long does it take to get started?\
\
Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial. For larger rollouts, our 4-hour Onboarding Packs or certified partners get you live in 1–2 weeks.\
\
### Can I migrate from Salesforce or HubSpot?\
\
Yes. Import your data via CSV, or use our API for 50,000+ records. Our partners can handle the full migration for you.\
\
### Do I need a developer to customize Twenty?\
\
No. Build custom objects, fields, views, and no-code workflows straight from Settings. Unlimited, no extra charge.\
\
### Can developers extend Twenty with code?\
\
Yes, with our Apps framework. Scaffold an extension with \`npx create-twenty-app\` and ship custom objects, server-side logic functions, React components that render inside Twenty’s UI, AI skills and agents, views, and navigation, all in TypeScript, deployable to any workspace.\
\
### Does Twenty work with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor?\
\
Yes. Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data in natural language.\
\
### What does Twenty cost?\
\
Cloud Pro is $9/user/month (yearly). Organization is $19/user/month and unlocks SSO and row-level permissions for teams that need finer access control.
